concerns.text: FR-004 specifies a Likelihood‑Ratio Test that compares a *linear* model of correctness (binary 0/1) vs. a piecewise‑linear model. Using a linear (Gaussian) regression on a binary outcome is statistically invalid; the appropriate model is a logistic (or other binomial) GLM. The current specification risks producing misleading p‑values and undermines the claimed non‑linear “reasoning cliff” detection.
